addAsset((address,(uint256,uint16,uint16.details: Adds a new asset to the portfolio. If _oldToken is address(0), all      existing assets are re-scaled proportionally to make room for the new one.      If _oldToken is specified, the new token takes allocation from the old one.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._oldToken: Address of an existing token to take allocation from (address(0) for re-scale all).
params._tokenToAdd: Configuration of the new token to add.

constructor.details: Initializes the StockWallet contract with the base token, Uniswap V3      infrastructure, the AI agent addresses, and the initial asset allocation.      The sum of all allocationBps must equal TOTAL_PERCENTAGE (10_000).

params._adgent: Address of the AI agent that will manage investments.
params._adgentContract: Address of the adgent's contract that receives fees.
params._adgentPercentage: Percentage of each investment sent to the adgent (in bps).
params._factory: Uniswap V3 Factory address for pool discovery.
params._quoter: Uniswap V3 Quoter V2 address for price quotes.
params._quoterV4: Uniswap V4 Quoter address for V4 quotes.
params._tokenToInvest: Array of tokens with their initial allocation configs.
params._usdc: Address of the base token (USDC/USDT) used for all investments.

depositAsset(address,uint256,bytes).details: Deposits a token into the contract. If the token is not the base      token (USDC), it gets swapped to USDC via Uniswap V3.      The caller must approve the contract to spend the token first.

params._path: Custom Uniswap V3 swap path (empty for auto-detection).
params._token: Address of the token to deposit.

getFirstAddress(bytes).details: Extracts the first address from a Uniswap V3 encoded path.

returns._0: The first address in the path.

getLastAddress(bytes).details: Extracts the last address from a Uniswap V3 encoded path.      A path is encoded as: address + fee + address + fee + ... + address

returns._0: The last address in the path.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

getTokenConfig(address).details: Returns the full configuration for a given asset.

params._token: Address of the token to query.

returns._0: AssetConfig struct containing allocation, stop loss, and take profit.

getV4Pools(address).details: Devuelve las pools V4 de compra guardadas para un token.

returns._0: Array de V4PoolData (ruta de compra: USDC -> token).

getV4SellPools(address).details: Devuelve las pools V4 de venta guardadas para un token.

returns._0: Array de V4PoolData (ruta de venta: token -> USDC).

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

invest(bytes[],(address,address,uint24,i.details: Executes the investment strategy: distributes the available USDC balance      across all configured assets according to their allocation percentages.      A gas fee and an adgent fee are deducted from the total before investing.      Only the AI agent (ADGENT_ROLE) can call this function.

params._path: Array of custom swap paths (empty for auto-detection).
params._v4Pools: V4 pools for each asset (empty array = use V3 or stored V4 pools).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

removeAsset(address).details: Removes an asset from the portfolio. The remaining assets are      re-scaled to maintain the total allocation at 100%.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._removedToken: Address of the token to remove.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). Emits a {RoleRevoked} event if the calling account had `role` and this call successfully revoked it. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

selltoken(address,bytes,(address,address.details: Sells a specific token if the stop loss or take profit condition is met.      Stop loss: sells all tokens and removes the asset from the portfolio.      Take profit: sells only the profit portion (difference between current      balance and the equivalent of the original investment at current price).      Only the AI agent (ADGENT_ROLE) can call this function.

params._token: Address of the token to sell.
params._v4Pools: V4 pools for the swap route (empty array = use V3 or stored V4 pools).

selltokenAll(bytes[]).details: Sells all assets in the portfolio, converting everything back to USDC.      Resets all positions. Only the owner can call this function.

params._path: Array of custom swap paths (empty for auto-detection).

setGasToken(address).details: Sets the token used to pay gas fees to the adgent.      address(0) or usdc = pay in USDC (default, no swap needed).      Any other address = swap USDC → gasToken before sending to adgent.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._gasToken: Address of the gas token (e.g. WBNB, WETH, CELO).

setV4Pools(address,(address,address,uint.details: Guarda o actualiza los parámetros de pools V4 para un token específico.      Guarda las pools de compra (USDC -> token) en v4BuyPoolsByToken      y las pools de venta (token -> USDC) en v4SellPoolsByToken (con la ruta invertida).      Solo el owner o el AI agent pueden actualizar.

params._pools: Array de pools V4 que conforman la ruta USDC -> _token (compra).

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unlockCallback(bytes).details: Called by PoolManager during unlock. Executes swap sequence:      1. For each hop: poolManager.swap()      2. Settle input token (sync + transfer + settle)      3. Take output token (currencyDelta + take)

updateAdgent(address).details: Updates the AI agent address. Revokes the old agent's role and grants      it to the new one. Only the owner can call this function.

params._newAdgent: Address of the new AI agent.

updateAdgentContract(address).details: Updates the adgent contract address that receives the agent fee.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._newAdgentContract: Address of the new adgent contract.

updateAdgentPercentage(uint256).details: Updates the percentage of each investment sent to the adgent contract.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._newPercentage: New adgent percentage in basis points (e.g. 100 = 1%).

updateAllocation(address,uint256).details: Updates the allocation percentage of a specific asset. The remaining      assets are re-scaled proportionally to maintain 100% total allocation.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._token: Address of the token to update.

updateGasFee(uint256).details: Updates the gas fee percentage charged on each investment.      Only the owner can call this function.

params._newGasFee: New gas fee in basis points (e.g. 500 = 5%).

updateRiskConfig(address,uint256,uint256.details: Updates the risk configuration (stop loss and take profit) for a      specific asset. Stop loss must be less than take profit, and both      must be valid (0 or >= TOTAL_PERCENTAGE for TP, 0 or <= TOTAL_PERCENTAGE for SL).      Only the owner can call this function.

params._stopLossBps: New stop loss in basis points (e.g. 9500 = 5% loss).
params._takeProfitBps: New take profit in basis points (e.g. 11000 = 10% gain).
params._token: Address of the token to update.

withdrawAsset(address).details: Withdraws all balance of a specific token from the contract.      Resets the position for that token. Only the owner can call this.

params._token: Address of the token to withdraw.

withdrawAssetUsdt(uint256).details: Withdraws a specific amount of the base token (USDC) from the contract.      Only the owner can call this function.

ADGENT_ROLE().notice: Role identifier for the AI agent

assetConfig(address).notice: Configuration for each asset (allocation, stop loss, take profit)

assetPath(address).notice: Custom swap paths for each asset

assetPosition(address).notice: Current position for each asset (amount held, amount invested)

assets(uint256).notice: Array of all active asset tokens

factory().notice: Uniswap V3 Factory used to find pools

gasToken().notice: Token used to pay gas fees. address(0) = USDC (default),         any other address = swap USDC → gasToken before sending to adgent

paused().notice: Pause total — bloquea todo excepto withdrawals

quoter().notice: Uniswap V3 Quoter V2 used to get price quotes

quoterV4().notice: Uniswap V4 Quoter for on-chain quotes (replaces manual tick iteration)

tradingPaused().notice: Pause de trading — bloquea solo invest y selltoken del agente

usdc().notice: Base token (USDC/USDT) used for all investments

v4BuyPoolsByToken(address,uint256).notice: Pools V4 para compra (USDC -> token). Indexadas por token destino.

v4SellPoolsByToken(address,uint256).notice: Pools V4 para venta (token -> USDC). Indexadas por token origen.
